notes: The לְ of the מִן … לְ range takes the written 'and', standing where the connective stands, on rule 26's reading of בֵּין X לְ Y; its assimilated article is unrepresented, no 'the' being written (rules 12, 29).
מִבְּלִי is fused here because the ASV spends the single word 'without' on the pair, the one-rendering condition of rule 30 being met on this verse's own English.
'any' is the supplied quantifying determiner on the substantival participle and joins its unit (rule 15); the final 'it' supplies an object no morpheme licenses and is added (rules 44, 30).
